lead.claim: Exercise alone sharpens thinking in older adults without dementia.
lead.context: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies compared exercise-only and exercise-plus-lifestyle programs for executive function, memory and processing speed.

supporting.claim: Resilience and health literacy predict better function after spinal cord injury.
supporting.context: A 6-month follow-up of 367 inpatients with traumatic spinal cord injury looked at which factors predicted functional ability; overall gains were modest.

supporting.claim: For teen basketball players, multimodal HIIT beat games and drills for fitness.
supporting.context: A randomized controlled trial of 36 adolescent players compared multimodal HIIT with small-sided games and drill-based HIIT on aerobic capacity and sprint time.

supporting.claim: Read FIM cognitive scores item by item at stroke discharge.
supporting.context: A retrospective observational study of 974 patients found heterogeneity across items and two linked pairs: comprehension with expression, memory with problem solving.

supporting.claim: VR-guided robotic gait training looks technically feasible for children.
supporting.context: A technical validation of the Discover2Walk platform in typically developing children tested speed and direction control; clinical efficacy data are still lacking.
